backend_note: auto = faster-whisper (CTranslate2), or mlx-whisper on an Apple Silicon Mac once mlx_verified is true; ct2 | mlx force one ('faster-whisper' = ct2, the 2.x name).
mlx_verified_note: Set true only after the Mac parity test (MLX vs faster-whisper on Arabic: same text, words within 80 ms; T9.3).
gpu_compute_types_note: NVIDIA GPU precision per model (T4.14, G13), set in a client profile, e.g. {"large-v3": "int8_float16"}; the processor always runs int8 (compute_type). Empty here: the shipped choice is in the engine (float16 for large-v3 and large-v3-turbo: there is no editor-verified reference transcript yet, so by the rule int8_float16 cannot win; Not verified: no reference; large-v3-turbo is not measured, not downloaded). Speed, VRAM and agreement: docs/superpowers/evidence/2026-10-17-g13-transcription-precision.md. Order: this map for the model, else the old gpu_compute_type from a profile, else the engine's choice, else float16; an unknown value is skipped. Episode checkpoints do not record the precision, so change it between runs with --force.
cpu_threads_note: Whisper threads on the CPU: auto = the physical cores (faster-whisper's own default is 4), or a number.
batch_size_note: NVIDIA GPU only, on audio that VAD splits (episodes, clips longer than long_clip_minutes): segments decoded together; a segment that repeats itself, is likely silence or holds a known hallucination phrase is decoded again one by one. An out-of-memory error halves it before falling back to the CPU. 4 measured fastest with a vocabulary hint on an 8 GB RTX 4060 (8 was slower and erratic); 0 = one after another (the 2.x path).
long_clip_note: A clip longer than long_clip_minutes is transcribed like an episode: chunks of about chunk_minutes cut in silence, VAD, resumable checkpoints in 02_transcription/chunks/. 0 = always one pass.
keep_phrases_note: End-screen phrases this client really says (a host who always asks viewers to subscribe): the hallucination filter never drops them. One-off: "restore" in transcript-corrections.json.
initial_prompt_note: Vocabulary hint set per client profile (name + specialty from the client's own brief). It biases spelling only; never used to insert content. null = disabled.
